name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door.' and 'Pick up the box in the other room.' are two independent commands in separate sentences with no order word linking them, so the two hard Existence clauses (door_open, target_picked_up) capture exactly what is required; no Precedence is stated by the task, and no clause is redundant. FINAL_STATES is nonempty and both goals are rewarded.

texts: Open the door at least once.
Pick up the box in the other room at least once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u3) -> 12
(u1, door_open, u3) -> 11
(u2, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
